comment: Level 1. Read by BOTH the game (controlquest/gameplay/level_data.py) and the engine (engine_server/level_rules/common.py). Calibrated with engine_server/calibrate.py.

knobs.name: q_p
knobs.label: Position weight
knobs.help: How much being away from the target costs. Q = diag(q_p, q_p, q_v, q_v).

knobs.name: q_v
knobs.label: Velocity weight
knobs.help: How much moving fast costs (the target velocity is 0).

knobs.name: r
knobs.label: Input weight
knobs.help: How much accelerating costs. R = r * I.
